correctness.rationale: A centered Euclidean vertex embedding with squared edge lengths equal to prices yields Rayleigh upper certificate lambda2 <= B/F. In each price phase explicit 1D or regular-polygon transverse embeddings achieve F; proposed positive rates saturate budget and make an increasing 4-block longitudinal path vector a generalized eigenvector of eigenvalue B/F. Strict Sturm ordering and separate leaf-difference modes exclude lower nonzero eigenvalues, giving exact optimality and endpoint multiplicity. Equality of the geometric certificate forces each pendant conductance and then bridge conductance, proving uniqueness even without imposing class symmetry. A separate construction of the full Laplacian for 6 price and leaf-count instances reproduced gap B/F and exact budget equality numerically, in support of analytical proof. Source SymPy verifier for 368 cases inspected, not treated as a universal proof.
